tasks.instruction: Write a discussion response. An effective response contains at least 100 words.

professor.name: Dr. Achebe
professor.text: We've been discussing the role of nature versus nurture in human development. Some experts believe that genetics play the most significant role in shaping who we are, while others argue that our environment and experiences are more important. Which do you think has a greater impact on human development: nature or nurture? Why?

posts.name: Claire
posts.text: I think nurture has a greater impact on human development. Our environment and experiences shape our beliefs, behaviors, and personalities. While genetics provide a foundation, it is our interactions and experiences that truly define who we become.

posts.name: Paul
posts.text: In my opinion, nature has a more significant role. Genetics determine many aspects of our personality, intelligence, and physical abilities. While the environment can influence these traits, our genetic makeup is the primary factor in shaping who we are.

tasks.sample: I agree with the proposal that nurture has a greater impact on human development. First of all, the way people are raised, the education they receive, and the people they interact with can strongly influence their personality and values. For example, children who grow up in families that encourage discussion and reading often develop stronger communication skills and perform better in critical thinking tasks. In addition, people often change over time as they gain new experiences, which suggests that nurture continues to shape who we are throughout life. While it is true that genetics can affect traits such as intelligence and physical abilities, these traits do not develop in isolation. A supportive environment can help individuals reach their full potential, while a negative environment may limit their development, despite their genetic advantages. Therefore, nurture has a greater impact on human development.
